lessons.claim: Observation.ready_for_system had ZERO call sites while four consumers (cli.py 102/115/140/155, physical.py 223, interactions.py 296) each re-derived readiness from open_missing alone. Adding a blocker to the property alone would have changed nothing. Measured 2026-09-02. Fix: Observation.blockers is now the single source and ready_for_system is defined as 'not blockers'.
